entities.summary: Ukhta State Technical University is a representative of Russian oil and gas universities and a technical higher education institution of the European North of Russia. The university was founded on the basis of the Ukhta Industrial Institute. By this time, more than 25000 engineers and economists had graduated in oil, geology, building, and timber industry majors. After the successful attestation on April 14, 1999, the institute was granted a status of a State Technical University.
